## Void Deck 0.2.14

- **The keyboard is a matrix now.** The on-screen keyboard is rebuilt as a black panel of square keys with hairline borders — no rounded keycaps, no gray fill. The letters are set in the same dot matrix as the numbers on the Home screen, and the modifier words (SHIFT, TAB, ENTER, SPACE) in Space Mono. The key you are on turns solid white with a black letter, so you always know where you are typing.
- **The letters are actually themed.** The old theme styled a class Steam only ships with the combined keyboard, so on the Deck the letters were never touched at all. Void Deck now paints the real key: the letter is a bare span inside the key, and it gets the right type, size and color — and it inverts with the key when focused.
- **The rest of the keyboard follows.** The text line is a black field with a dot grid and a white block cursor, the emoji, Steam item and IME tiles are flat square cells, the category switcher inverts to a white cell, and the action buttons (ABC, EMOJI, THEME, LAYOUT) are square outlines that invert on focus.

**Install / update:** Decky → ⚙ → Developer → *Install Plugin from ZIP*, then select `VoidDeck-v0.2.14.zip` from this release.
